item.title: Meta & EssilorLuxottica Sold 7 Million Smart Glasses In 2025
item.description: Meta and EssilorLuxottica sold more than 7 million smart glasses in 2025, and they were the "dominant driver" of the Ray-Ban owner's wholesale growth in H2.

item.title: Narrative Puzzle Game Tin Hearts: Act 1 Marches Onto Quest
item.description: Charming clockwork puzzler Tin Hearts: Act 1 arrives on Quest today, bringing its heartfelt story and inventive Lemmings-like gameplay to standalone headsets.

item.title: nDreams' Chaotic Sandbox Wreckin' Raccoon Is Out Now On Quest
item.description: Unhinged chaos sim Wreckin' Raccoon, nDreams' answer to games like I Am Cat and Gorilla Tag, has left Early Access for full release on Quest.

item.title: Titan Isles Is Coming To PlayStation VR2 This Month
item.description: Titan Isles brings its high-speed aerial combat to PlayStation VR2 this month.

item.title: YouTube Launches Official Apple Vision Pro App
item.description: Google's YouTube launched an official app for Apple Vision Pro headsets, just over two years after the original's launch.

item.title: Forefront Is Coming To PlayStation VR2 This Year
item.description: The Battlefield-like 32-player VR FPS Forefront is coming to PlayStation VR2 later this year.

item.title: Orcs Must Die! By The Blade Out Now On Quest 3
item.description: Orcs Must Die! By The Blade, the VR reimagining of the long-running tower-defense series, is available now on Quest 3 and 3S.

item.title: Amelia's Escape Impressions: A Bit De-Myst-ifying
item.description: Amelia's Escape has promise, but issues with controls and puzzle readability make this a release we'll need to see more of before recommending.

item.title: Bootstrap Island To Exit Early Access Next Month
item.description: Two years after debuting in Early Access on Steam, VR survival game Bootstrap Island moves to its 1.0 release in March.

item.title: Quest 3S On Sale For $250 With Batman: Arkham Shadow Again At Walmart
item.description: Walmart is offering Quest 3S for $250 again, $50 off, and it comes with the $50 VR blockbuster Batman: Arkham Shadow.
